g.text: Grey arrows: service handovers. Blue arrows: data flows. Scan&Go repeats stages 2-3 while shopping.
Internal activities and data links show a proposed service design. Tally availability varies by store.
Sources: Bitner et al. (2008); Carrefour UAE (n.d.); Majid Al Futtaim (2022).
